purpose: Muestras ilustrativas de entregables de Diseño Gráfico; no se atribuyen como proyectos reales entregados por los autores de los perfiles.

specs.title: Diseño de Identidad Visual y Logotipo Profesional
specs.prompt:
Create ONE finished portfolio cover image for the named graphic-design service. Wide landscape canvas 2400 x 1000 (12:5). The service's FINISHED DELIVERABLE must be the dominant subject, clearly identifiable in a small card thumbnail. No art supplies, blank stationery, paint brushes, material swatches as the main subject, workshop scenes, or generic desk photographs. No added headline, badge, caption or decorative label outside the actual design. No glow, neon, gradients, floating objects, invented decorative connector lines, futuristic graphics, glossy CGI, or 3D rendering. Any lettering requested below belongs to the finished design itself and must be clean, correctly spelled and professionally typeset. No real brand logos.
Deliverable: a completed cohesive visual identity and custom logotype, not a designer's tools.
Show a strong polished custom wordmark reading "NOMA" with a simple memorable architectural arch emblem, consistently applied across a main identity layout and two finished applications. Make the primary wordmark prominent on a cream area, with an alternate reversed white mark on a deep cobalt panel and a small pair of professionally designed business-card faces showing the same mark. This is a crisp FLAT 2D portfolio presentation of the actual finished graphic artwork, not a 3D mockup or a photograph of blank paper. Refined contemporary typography, deliberate proportions and useful negative space. Ink-black, cream and cobalt. All applications must carry real completed design. Do not add presentation labels such as 'branding', 'logo', or 'service'.

specs.title: Pack de 12 Piezas Gráficas para Redes Sociales
specs.prompt:
Create ONE finished portfolio cover image for the named graphic-design service. Wide landscape canvas 2400 x 1000 (12:5). The service's FINISHED DELIVERABLE must be the dominant subject, clearly identifiable in a small card thumbnail. No art supplies, blank stationery, paint brushes, material swatches as the main subject, workshop scenes, or generic desk photographs. No added headline, badge, caption or decorative label outside the actual design. No glow, neon, gradients, floating objects, invented decorative connector lines, futuristic graphics, glossy CGI, or 3D rendering. Any lettering requested below belongs to the finished design itself and must be clean, correctly spelled and professionally typeset. No real brand logos.
Deliverable: twelve completed DIGITAL social-media posts, not printed photo samples.
Show a professional coordinated set of exactly 12 distinct square digital post artworks in 6 columns and 2 rows, a tight horizontal overview with small consistent gutters. All squares are flat digital graphics with no paper texture, perspective, curled edges, desk, phone, social-app chrome, handles or UI icons. A fictional neighborhood bakery called "MIGA": warm brick red, butter cream and dark brown, strong readable Spanish typography paired with appetizing natural bread/pastry photography. Alternate product-photo layouts, type-led announcements and calm editorial compositions; vary the designs while keeping one identity. Use only short purposeful phrases within the posts, such as "MIGA", "Recién hecho", "Masa madre", "Del horno", "Buen pan", "Hecho aquí". The result must look like a designer's usable final social media files, no generic moodboard and no outside heading.

specs.title: Diseño de Packaging y Etiquetas de Producto

Deliverable: completed packaging AND product label design.
Make a believable photographic close-up of finished packaging for a fictional everyday care brand named "SAVIA": an amber glass liquid soap bottle with a correctly fitted professionally printed cream-and-muted-sage label, its matching printed folding carton, and one small matching soap carton. Clearly legible designed wordmark "SAVIA" and restrained supporting product copy "Jabón líquido" and "250 ml" on the bottle. A distinct elegant leaf motif is part of the printed identity, not an overlay. The cartons also carry the completed coherent visual identity with real typography, print margins and restrained botanical artwork; absolutely no blank prototypes or empty unlabelled jars. Real matte printed cardboard grain, folds, subtle handling imperfections, ordinary glass reflections, soft side window light on a plain warm-gray surface. Physically grounded objects with correct contact shadows and practical scale, not levitating mockups, no cinematic glow or shiny 3D product render.
